Temps plein

Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Description de l'entreprise
Cream is an IT consulting firm based in Brussels, with a proven experience in combining Technology Vision, Talent Motivation and Continuous Business Improvement what we call Enterprise Agility.
We carry out innovative projects (problem solving, business efficiency improvement, new product development...) for industry leaders in Europe and innovative start-ups throughout the world in Finance, Utilities, Distribution & Industry
We offer services in:
* Enterprise Architecture
* SOA & Integration
* Software Delivery
* Quality Insurrance
* Business Intelligence
* Project Office & IT Governance
* Infrastructure
Description de la fonction
What is a Business Analyst in insurance domain at cream?
As Nicole, Business Analyst at Cream, embrace your role and support the different applications in the insurance industry (life and non life). Your tasks will be
Participate and lead requirements gathering sessions with clients
Produce Functional Design and Requirements Specification documents on domains of expertise e.g. New Business, Claims, etc.
Implement, in means of configuration, relevant aspects of the client's requirements
Write/ Review test plans
Perform expert testing and defect management following development/configuration
Conduct training sessions on the system and its configured product set
Production support including UAT testing, defect analysis and Change Requests management
Perform gap analysis
What do we expect from our Consultant ?
You have a Master degree or equivalent experience
Minimum 5 years of experience, including minimum 3 years of experience within an insurance company
You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables
You are fluent in French and a good command of English, Dutch is a plus
You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request.
Why should you taste the lime flavor ?
A strong learning environment: tribes, training budget
Career follow-up with dedicated Business Managers and an associate plan
Attractive benefits package (mobility plan, meal vouchers, insurances,...)
Hybrid working model: client working, home working & Cream working
Strong Csr commitments, with recognized labels in environmental responsibility and diversity & inclusion.
A consulting company of around 200 Creamers, located in the center of Brussels
Our recruitment process is clear and structured, with three steps and feedback throughout.
Cream Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. If you need any specific accommodation to fully participate in the recruitment process or the interview, please let us know.
Think this role is a match? Apply and let's talk, or explore our other opportunities at Cream.
